services.name: PWD Assistance
services.details: PWD ID, the 2026 PWD Cash Gift and benefits for persons with disability under the Magna Carta for Disabled Persons (RA 7277, as amended).
services.eligibility: Taytay residents with a permanent disability.

requirements.text: Original and photocopy of your updated PWD ID (for the cash gift)
For a new PWD ID: medical certificate or certificate of disability
1×1 ID photo

services.name: Senior Citizens (OSCA)
services.details: Senior Citizen ID and benefits for residents aged 60 and above under the Expanded Senior Citizens Act (RA 9994), including discounts on medicines and fares.

requirements.text: Valid ID or birth certificate showing age
Proof of residency (e.g. barangay certificate)
1×1 ID photo

locations.name: Where
locations.address: MSWD Office, Ground Floor, Municipal Hall

presentation.source: Benefits: RA 9994. Taytay-specific requirements: SAMPLE, to confirm with MSWDO/OSCA.

services.name: Solo Parents
services.details: Solo Parent ID and benefits under the Expanded Solo Parents Welfare Act (RA 11861).
services.eligibility: Parents raising a child alone, as defined by RA 11861 (e.g. widowed, separated, or spouse detained or abroad).

requirements.text: Barangay certificate of residency
Birth certificates of the children
Proof of solo parent status (e.g. death certificate, court decree)

locations.name: Where
locations.address: MSWD Office, Ground Floor, Municipal Hall

services.name: Crisis Assistance (AICS)
services.details: Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation: medical, burial, food and transport aid, after a social worker's assessment.
services.eligibility: Individuals and families in crisis, as assessed by a social worker.

requirements.text: One valid ID of the client
Medical: medical certificate or clinical abstract, and bill or prescription
Burial: death certificate and funeral contract
Barangay certificate of indigency or residency

locations.name: Where
locations.address: MSWD Office, Ground Floor, Municipal Hall

presentation.source: Requirements: DSWD AICS Citizen's Charter (national). Taytay MSWDO may ask for more.

services.name: Educational Assistance
services.details: Help with school expenses for students from families in need. Not for graduate studies.
services.eligibility: Students from indigent or vulnerable families, as assessed by a social worker.

requirements.text: Certificate of enrolment or registration form
Validated school ID of the student
Barangay certificate of indigency or residency
Valid ID of the parent or claimant

services.name: Women & Children
services.details: Protection, counselling and referral for women and children, including victims of abuse and human trafficking.
services.eligibility: Any woman or child at risk, or anyone reporting a case.

requirements.text: No documents needed to ask for help
Bring any ID or reports you have (optional)

services.eligibility: Job seekers in Taytay, including first-time job seekers.

Certificates or diplomas, if any
